description: Prepare the repayment of a Priors agent's open loans: list what is due and return two links where the agent's owner repays: Go mode (go.priors.trade, their account, all loans in one click) or Builder mode (priors.trade/agent, the wallet that owns the agent, one loan at a time). Nothing is repaid by this tool: no key, no transaction. Use it when the user wants to repay the loans of an agent they own.
name: request_repay
title: Ask to repay an agent's Priors loans
